channel.title: Extension on Vibe Coding
channel.description: Recent content in Extension on Vibe Coding

item.title: GitHub Copilot
item.description: Copilot started as an autocomplete extension and has grown into a full assistant: inline suggestions, a chat pane, a CLI, and an agent mode that can open pull requests on its own.

item.title: Cline
item.description: Cline is an open-source VS Code extension that acts as an autonomous agent — creating and editing files, running terminal commands, and even using a browser — while showing exactly what it plans to do before it does it.

item.title: Tabnine
item.description: Tabnine focuses on enterprise privacy and control: it can run fully air-gapped or in a private cloud, and its Enterprise Context Engine tunes suggestions to an organization’s own codebase rather than relying solely on public training data.

item.title: Continue.dev
item.description: Continue.dev is an open-source extension that adds chat, autocomplete, and agentic editing to VS Code or a JetBrains IDE, with every model provider — hosted or fully local — configurable through one JSON config file rather than being tied to a single vendor.

item.title: CodeGPT
item.description: CodeGPT is an IDE extension that adds AI chat, autocomplete, and agent workflows to VS Code and JetBrains IDEs, with a bring-your-own-key model that lets you connect the provider and model of your choice rather than routing through a single fixed backend.

item.title: Blackbox AI
item.description: Blackbox AI is a multi-model coding assistant that works both as a standalone web chat and as an extension across more than 30 IDEs, giving developers code search, autocomplete, image-to-code, and agentic app-building from a single account.

item.title: Zencoder
item.description: Zencoder is an IDE extension built around a repo-grokking engine that indexes an entire codebase so its agent can plan, edit, and test changes across multiple files with a fuller picture of the project than single-file context provides.
